description: "Voyages of Peter Esprit Radisson" by Pierre Esprit Radisson is a historical account likely written in the late 19th century. This work chronicles the travels and experiences of the author among the North American Indians from 1652 to 1684, highlighting his interactions and significant events encountered during this tumultuous period.
